Description: Calendar date on which wholesale mandi trading prices were recorded.
Domain_Significance: Temporal index used for time-series sequence ordering and chronological validation.

Description: Name of the agricultural crop being transacted (Wheat, Maize, or Brinjal).
Domain_Significance: Categorical feature capturing commodity-specific storage characteristics and perishability.

Description: Wholesale agricultural market yard (mandi) where transactions took place.
Domain_Significance: Spatial entity representing regional supply-demand equilibrium and local trading infrastructure.

Description: Most frequently occurring wholesale clearing price of the day (INR per Quintal).
Domain_Significance: Primary target variable for forecasting and historical benchmark evaluations.

Description: Day of the week (Monday=0, Sunday=6).
Domain_Significance: Captures intra-week market trading rhythms and weekend mandi closure effects.

Description: Calendar month of the year (January=1 to December=12).
Domain_Significance: Captures broad annual harvesting and procurement seasons (Rabi vs Kharif seasons).

Description: ISO standard calendar week number of the year.
Domain_Significance: Provides fine-grained seasonal representation of annual crop arrival cycles.

Description: Wholesale modal price from exactly 1 day prior (t-1).
Domain_Significance: Captures high short-term price persistence and immediate market memory.

Description: Wholesale modal price from exactly 7 days prior (t-7).
Domain_Significance: Weekly seasonal baseline; forms the core signal for the Seasonal Naive persistence model.

Description: Wholesale modal price from exactly 14 days prior (t-14).
Domain_Significance: Fortnightly momentum and multi-week trend anchor.

Description: Wholesale modal price from exactly 30 days prior (t-30).
Domain_Significance: Monthly baseline price level capturing broader macroeconomic shifts.

Description: 7-day rolling average modal price computed over shifted past observations (shift(1)).
Domain_Significance: Smoothed weekly price level; shift(1) strictly prevents look-ahead target leakage.

Description: 7-day rolling standard deviation of modal price computed over shifted past observations.
Domain_Significance: Measures short-term price volatility and market arrival instability.

Description: 30-day rolling average modal price computed over shifted past observations (shift(1)).
Domain_Significance: Monthly trend benchmark filtered from day-to-day noise.

Description: 30-day rolling standard deviation of modal price computed over shifted past observations.
Domain_Significance: Quantifies medium-term macroeconomic price volatility and structural market swings.

Description: Daily mean surface air temperature at 2 meters altitude in Celsius (°C).
Domain_Significance: Retrieved from Open-Meteo API; reflects local thermal stress impacting crop perishability.

Description: Maximum daily surface air temperature in Celsius (°C).
Domain_Significance: Indicates extreme heat conditions that accelerate post-harvest spoilage in transit.

Description: Minimum daily surface air temperature in Celsius (°C).
Domain_Significance: Indicates nocturnal thermal levels affecting crop storage and field harvesting.

Description: Total daily precipitation recorded across the market area in millimeters (mm).
Domain_Significance: Heavy rainfall causes rural road disruptions, reduces mandi arrivals, and triggers temporary price spikes.

Description: Maximum recorded daily wind speed at 10 meters altitude in km/h.
Domain_Significance: Severe wind storm indicator associated with transportation friction and local weather disruptions.
